title: White Embroidered Cotton Tunic Top for Women with Black Thread Work – Short Kurti for Jeans
description:
Kajal is the black kohl that lines the eyes – a crisp white tunic, outlined in black.

Fresh, graphic and easy to love. This white cotton tunic is scattered with black thread-embroidered buttis and leafy sprigs, with a fuller motif row across the yoke. A small mandarin collar with a front slit keeps it neat, and the top gathers softly below the yoke into a light peplum flare that sits beautifully over jeans.

✦ The Details
• Mandarin collar with a front slit neckline
• Black thread embroidery – sprigs and buttis on the yoke, body and sleeves
• Gathered below the yoke for a soft peplum flare
• 3/4 sleeves with a gentle bell shape
• Hip length, easy pull-on style

✦ Fabric & Craft
100% cotton – soft, breathable and comfortable all day. The black embroidery stands out sharply on white for a clean, monochrome look.

✦ Fit & Size
Relaxed, flowy fit through the body. Choose your usual top size.

✦ How to Style It
Light blue flared jeans, clear heels and silver jhumkas, as in our photos; white trousers for office; black jeans and sneakers for college; cat-eye sunglasses for an easy city look.

✦ The Bahe Promise
• Made in Jaipur – we send you photos of your piece before it ships
• Free custom fit on request – share your measurements
• Free worldwide shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE & Australia – duties & taxes included, with tracking
• Real people on WhatsApp to help with size and styling

The colour may look slightly different on your screen.
care: Gentle hand wash in cold water separately for the first wash. Do not bleach. Dry in shade and iron on medium heat on the reverse side.
